name: Actinidia chinensis extract
description: Actinidia chinensis extract (CAS 92456-63-8 ), also sourced and listed under Actinidia Deliciosa Fruit Extract, is a botanical extract derived from kiwifruit. It delivers concentrated flavor, antioxidant activity, and nutritional compounds across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical applications. In food and beverage formulation, it provides authentic kiwifruit flavor and natural acidulant character to functional drinks, fruit preparations, and confectionery. Nutraceutical and supplement manufacturers incorporate it as a source of antioxidant compounds. These manufacturers support finished products positioned around fruit-derived nutrition. In personal care, it is used in skin-targeting formulations such as serums, masks, and creams where fruit extracts are specified for antioxidant and brightening positioning. Pharmaceutical and healthcare product developers also evaluate it for standardized botanical ingredient applications where kiwifruit-derived actives are required. This versatile extract meets various industry needs for natural fruit-based components. Actinidia chinensis extract is supplied as a dry powder or liquid extract, with dry forms being the most common for supplement and food applications. Buyers can typically source food-grade and cosmetic-grade material for their specific needs. Standardization levels vary by supplier, so specification sheets should confirm extract ratio and active marker compounds.
